title: Add destination_v14: back off a speed level only after 50 updates there
summary: On the surrogate, destination_v13's 10-update window reached 0.15 m/s within 40 updates but lowered it again after 10, and usually lowered 0.125 m/s after the next 10, so 0.15 m/s never trained for more than about 10 updates at a time. destination_v14 keeps the 10-update window for raising the level and judges the back-off on the last 50 updates at the level.
next: Train destination_v14 from the v9 checkpoint on the surrogate and test it against v9 at 0.05 to 0.15 m/s.
reason: A named experiment that no gate or registry entry uses yet; the canonical task and reward are unchanged.
